task_info.original_instruction:
Check the inbox for crm.assistant@company.com for any new support-related emails.

If there is an email from a customer requesting to cancel their service, you need to extract:
- The customer's name
- Their company name
- The cancellation request details

Then:
1. Find the matching lead or contact in the CRM by the customer's email address
2. Update their status to "Cancelled"
3. Add a note to the lead's description: "Service cancellation request received via email - [brief summary of request]"
4. Send a confirmation reply to the customer acknowledging their cancellation request. The email body must include the phrase: "Your service cancellation request has been processed. Your service will terminate at the end of the current billing period"

Dear Amanda,

Thank you for contacting us regarding your service cancellation request.

Your service cancellation request has been processed. Your service will terminate at the end of the current billing period.

We have noted your requests for:
- Data export before termination
- Final invoice for any outstanding charges

Our team will ensure all your data is securely exported and you will receive your final invoice along with confirmation of the cancellation date.

If you have any questions or need further assistance during this transition period, please don't hesitate to reach out.

We appreciate your business over the past 2 years and wish you all the best.

Best regards,
CRM Assistant
Company Support Team
